summary: Build credible science-based targets and decarbonization roadmaps with SBTi, GHG Protocol, and KPI tools. Enroll in 5-day training.
lede: Science-based targets and decarbonization roadmaps connect emissions data with practical reduction plans. For sustainability managers, ESG reporting specialists, carbon accountants and operations leaders, the course covers baseline calculations, abatement options and Scope 3 action mapping. It also addresses target governance and validation readiness, roadmap sequencing, scenario planning and KPI dashboards for tracking and reporting progress.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already touch climate data, sustainability reporting, or operational improvement and now need to build stronger science-based target and decarbonization roadmap capability.
prerequisites: You need a laptop, spreadsheet software, and basic familiarity with emissions data structures. It helps to bring a sample emissions inventory, a recent sustainability report, or any internal target-setting template you already use. The course will not require programming, but you should be ready to work with calculations, scenario inputs, and roadmap templates.
